purpose: Immutable source-side integrity contract for the non-negotiable 100-point Visual Fidelity Gate. This contract does not award visual points; it prevents accidental relaxation of the required scoring geometry before real Unity evidence is reviewed.
hardRules: The category weights above must sum to exactly 100 and each weight/hardMinimum pair is immutable unless the owner explicitly replaces the non-negotiable specification.
PASS requires total >= 92, every category >= its hard minimum, and every listed critical defect explicitly reviewed as absent against actual evidence.
The critical defect set is exact: entries may not be removed, renamed, substituted, duplicated, or silently supplemented as a way to change gate semantics.
Only native 3840x2160 hero, oblique and grazing Unity renders plus pixel-exact 100% crops qualify as still evidence.
Temporal/LOD/aliasing evidence remains separately sealed and must not be inferred from implementation settings.
Implementation Readiness never contributes Visual Fidelity points.
